examples.chinese: 最近很多人感冒，你要戴口罩、常洗手。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén gǎnmào, nǐ yào dài kǒuzhào, cháng xǐ shǒu.
examples.english: Recently many people have caught colds; you should wear a mask and wash your hands often.

examples.chinese: 他說：「你唱得很好。」這個中文句子對嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ chàng de hěn hǎo.” Zhège Zhōngwén jùzi duì ma?
examples.english: He said, “You sing very well.” Is this Chinese sentence correct?

examples.chinese: 我身體不舒服，所以不能跟你們去打球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shēntǐ bù shūfu, suǒyǐ bù néng gēn nǐmen qù dǎ qiú.
examples.english: I am not feeling well, so I cannot go play ball with you.

examples.chinese: 你記不記得張老師的電話號碼？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jì bù jìde Zhāng lǎoshī de diànhuà hàomǎ?
examples.english: Do you remember Teacher Zhang's phone number?

examples.chinese: A:聽說你弟弟生病了，他現在怎麼樣？ B:他好了，明天可以去學校了。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō nǐ dìdi shēngbìng le, tā xiànzài zěnmeyàng? B: Tā hǎo le, míngtiān kěyǐ qù xuéxiào le.
examples.english: A: I heard your younger brother got sick; how is he now? B: He has gotten well; he can go to school tomorrow.

examples.chinese: A:你寫功課了嗎？ B:我已經寫了。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiě gōngkè le ma? B: Wǒ yǐjīng xiě le.
examples.english: A: Have you done your homework? B: I have already done it.

examples.chinese: 如果他不能接電話，你就留言吧！
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ tā bù néng jiē diànhuà, nǐ jiù liúyán ba!
examples.english: If he can't answer the phone, then leave a message!

examples.chinese: A:你每天幾點起床？ B:差不多七點。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ měi tiān jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng? B: Chàbuduō qī diǎn.
examples.english: A: What time do you get up every day? B: About seven o'clock.

examples.chinese: 你們在聊什麼？聊得好開心。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zài liáo shénme? Liáo de hǎo kāixīn.
examples.english: What are you chatting about? You're chatting so happily.

examples.chinese: 你這個週末有空嗎？ 我想跟你見面。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhège zhōumò yǒu kòng ma? Wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ jiànmiàn.
examples.english: Are you free this weekend? I want to meet with you.

examples.chinese: A:你現在要回宿舍嗎？ B:還沒，我要先去吃飯再回宿舍。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiànzài yào huí sùshè ma? B: Hái méi, wǒ yào xiān qù chīfàn zài huí sùshè.
examples.english: A: Are you going back to the dorm now? B: Not yet; I want to go eat first and then go back to the dorm.

examples.chinese: A:昨天你去運動了嗎 ？ B:我沒去運動，我去朋友家玩。
examples.pinyin: A: Zuótiān nǐ qù yùndòng le ma? B: Wǒ méi qù yùndòng, wǒ qù péngyou jiā wán.
examples.english: A: Did you go exercise yesterday? B: I didn't go exercise; I went to a friend's house to have fun.

examples.chinese: A:你已經決定明年去英國了嗎？ B:我還沒做決定。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ yǐjīng juédìng míngnián qù Yīngguó le ma? B: Wǒ hái méi zuò juédìng.
examples.english: A: Have you already decided to go to England next year? B: I haven't made a decision yet.

examples.chinese: 你可以告訴我學中文的經驗嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ gàosu wǒ xué Zhōngwén de jīngyàn ma?
examples.english: Can you tell me about your experience learning Chinese?

examples.chinese: 這個孩子飯吃得太少了，你有什麼好辦法？
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi fàn chī de tài shǎo le, nǐ yǒu shénme hǎo bànfǎ?
examples.english: This child eats too little food; do you have any good method?

examples.chinese: 可以請你幫我一個忙嗎？
examples.pinyin: Kěyǐ qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ yí ge máng ma?
examples.english: Can I ask you to help me with a favor?

examples.chinese: A:你什麼時候有空？要不要跟我去唱歌？ B:我今天下午有空。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ shénme shíhou yǒu kòng? Yào bú yào gēn wǒ qù chànggē? B: Wǒ jīntiān xiàwǔ yǒu kòng.
examples.english: A: When are you free? Do you want to go sing with me? B: I'm free this afternoon.

examples.chinese: A:請問你們有英文菜單嗎？ B:對不起，我們沒有。
examples.pinyin: A: Qǐngwèn nǐmen yǒu Yīngwén càidān ma? B: Duìbuqǐ, wǒmen méiyǒu.
examples.english: A: Excuse me, do you have an English menu? B: Sorry, we don't.

examples.chinese: A:我們要點幾盤菜？ B:今天是你的生日，我們多點幾盤吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒmen yào diǎn jǐ pán cài? B: Jīntiān shì nǐ de shēngrì, wǒmen duō diǎn jǐ pán ba.
examples.english: A: How many dishes shall we order? B: Today is your birthday; let's order a few more dishes.

examples.chinese: A:你今天唱歌唱得真好聽？ B:因為我心情很好。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ jīntiān chànggē chàng de zhēn hǎotīng? B: Yīnwèi wǒ xīnqíng hěn hǎo.
examples.english: A: You sang really beautifully today! B: Because I'm in a very good mood.

examples.chinese: A:你現在有空嗎？ B:我現在要跟太太出去，晚上再給你打電話。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiànzài yǒu kòng ma? B: Wǒ xiànzài yào gēn tàitai chūqù, wǎnshàng zài gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.english: A: Are you free now? B: I'm going out with my wife now; I'll call you again in the evening.

examples.chinese: A:今天天氣很好，你怎麼沒出去？ B:今天我有很多功課，不能出去玩。
examples.pinyin: A: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, nǐ zěnme méi chūqù? B: Jīntiān wǒ yǒu hěn duō gōngkè, bù néng chūqù wán.
examples.english: A: The weather is so nice today; how come you didn't go out? B: I have a lot of homework today, so I can't go out and have fun.

examples.chinese: 你要參加學校的游泳比賽嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào cānjiā xuéxiào de yóuyǒng bǐsài ma?
examples.english: Are you going to participate in the school's swimming competition?

examples.chinese: A:你覺得我可以當老師嗎？ B:如果你想當，一定有機會。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ juéde wǒ kěyǐ dāng lǎoshī ma? B: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng dāng, yídìng yǒu jīhuì.
examples.english: A: Do you think I can be a teacher? B: If you want to be one, you'll definitely have a chance.

examples.chinese: 你這學期的成績進步了，太好了！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhè xuéqī de chéngjī jìnbù le, tài hǎo le!
examples.english: Your grades this semester have improved; that's great!

examples.chinese: 我的母親常對我說：「你要多看書，少玩手機。」
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de mǔqīn cháng duì wǒ shuō: “Nǐ yào duō kàn shū, shǎo wán shǒujī.”
examples.english: My mother often says to me: 'You should read more books and play less on your phone.'

examples.chinese: 現在我沒有時間，明天再跟你談這個問題。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān, míngtiān zài gēn nǐ tán zhège wèntí.
examples.english: I don't have time now; I'll talk about this issue with you tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 這是博物館的網址，你可以先看看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì bówùguǎn de wǎngzhǐ, nǐ kěyǐ xiān kànkan.
examples.english: This is the museum's web address; you can take a look first.

examples.chinese: 你知道他家的地址嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào tā jiā de dìzhǐ ma?
examples.english: Do you know his home address?

examples.chinese: 你先往左轉，再往右轉，就到那家餐廳了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān wǎng zuǒ zhuǎn, zài wǎng yòu zhuǎn, jiù dào nà jiā cāntīng le.
examples.english: First turn left, then turn right, and you'll arrive at that restaurant.

examples.chinese: 我明天早上十點會在學校門口等你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān zǎoshang shí diǎn huì zài xuéxiào ménkǒu děng nǐ.
examples.english: I will wait for you at the school gate at ten o'clock tomorrow morning.

examples.chinese: 現在很晚了，你應該去睡覺了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn wǎn le, nǐ yīnggāi qù shuìjiào le.
examples.english: It's very late now; you should go to sleep.

examples.chinese: 他們在裡面談話，你現在不要進去。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài lǐmiàn tánhuà, nǐ xiànzài búyào jìnqù.
examples.english: They are talking inside; don't go in now.

examples.chinese: 兒子跟女兒都在睡覺，你不要說得太大聲。
examples.pinyin: Érzi gēn nǚ'ér dōu zài shuìjiào, nǐ búyào shuō de tài dàshēng.
examples.english: Both my son and daughter are sleeping; don't speak too loudly.

examples.chinese: 請你先算一算，然後告訴我這裡一共有多少人。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ xiān suàn yi suàn, ránhòu gàosu wǒ zhèlǐ yígòng yǒu duōshao rén.
examples.english: Please calculate first, then tell me how many people there are here in total.

examples.chinese: 下個月有個很大的電腦展，你要跟我去看看嗎？
examples.pinyin: Xià ge yuè yǒu ge hěn dà de diànnǎo zhǎn, nǐ yào gēn wǒ qù kànkan ma?
examples.english: Next month there is a big computer exhibition; do you want to go see it with me?

examples.chinese: 你往前走，過第二個十字路口，就到了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wǎng qián zǒu, guò dì èr ge shízì lùkǒu, jiù dào le.
examples.english: Go straight ahead, pass the second intersection, and you'll arrive.

examples.chinese: 他不是壞人，你不要怕他。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú shì huàirén, nǐ búyào pà tā.
examples.english: He is not a bad person; don't be afraid of him.

examples.chinese: 你不要忘了告訴他明天有考試。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào wàng le gàosu tā míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì.
examples.english: Don't forget to tell him that there is an exam tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 你知道現在世界上有多少人嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào xiànzài shìjiè shàng yǒu duōshao rén ma?
examples.english: Do you know how many people there are in the world now?

examples.chinese: 今年你想要跟誰一起跨年？
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián nǐ xiǎng gēn shéi yìqǐ kuànián?
examples.english: Who do you want to celebrate New Year's Eve with this year?

examples.chinese: 你參加過什麼有趣的新年活動？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ cānjiā guò shénme yǒuqù de xīnnián huódòng?
examples.english: What interesting New Year activities have you participated in?

examples.chinese: 明天晚上學校有一個新年晚會，你會去參加嗎？
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǎnshang xuéxiào yǒu yī gè xīnnián wǎnhuì, nǐ huì qù cānjiā ma?
examples.english: Tomorrow evening the school has a New Year evening event, will you go to participate?

examples.chinese: 這個週末有一場演唱會，你要不要跟我一起去看？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò yǒu yī chǎng yǎnchànghuì, nǐ yào bu yào gēn wǒ yīqǐ qù kàn?
examples.english: This weekend there is a concert, do you want to go watch it with me?

examples.chinese: 你看書看了多久了？不累嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn shū kàn le duōjiǔ le? Bù lèi ma?
examples.english: How long have you been reading? Aren't you tired?

examples.chinese: 歡迎你們到我家來，請進。
examples.pinyin: Huānyíng nǐmen dào wǒ jiā lái, qǐng jìn.
examples.english: Welcome to my home, please come in.

examples.chinese: 如果你不想吃飯，可以只吃幾個餃子。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bù xiǎng chī fàn, kěyǐ zhǐ chī jǐ gè jiǎozi.
examples.english: If you don't want to eat rice, you can just eat a few dumplings.

examples.chinese: 這是我媽媽做的包子，你吃吃看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ māma zuò de bāozi, nǐ chī chī kàn.
examples.english: These are baozi made by my mother, try eating them.

examples.chinese: 從這裡往山上走，你就會看到很多牛。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ wǎng shān shàng zǒu, nǐ jiù huì kàndào hěn duō niú.
examples.english: If you walk up the mountain from here, you will see many cows.

examples.chinese: 這條魚很好吃，你多吃點兒。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo yú hěn hǎochī, nǐ duō chī diǎnr.
examples.english: This fish is delicious, eat a little more.

examples.chinese: 你很餓嗎？為什麼吃得這麼快？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hěn è ma? Wèishénme chī de zhème kuài?
examples.english: Are you very hungry? Why are you eating so fast?

examples.chinese: 你手裡拿的東西是什麼？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shǒu lǐ ná de dōngxī shì shénme?
examples.english: What is the thing you are holding in your hand?

examples.chinese: A:我覺得語言比數學有趣多了？ B:我同意你說的。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ juéde yǔyán bǐ shùxué yǒuqù duō le? B: Wǒ tóngyì nǐ shuō de.
examples.english: A: I think languages are much more interesting than math? B: I agree with what you said.

examples.chinese: 你知道台灣人怎麼慶祝新年嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào Táiwān rén zěnme qìngzhù xīnnián ma?
examples.english: Do you know how Taiwanese people celebrate the New Year?

examples.chinese: A:對不起，我不小心拿了你的書？ B:原來書在你這裡，我剛才在教室裡找了好久。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn ná le nǐ de shū? B: Yuánlái shū zài nǐ zhèlǐ, wǒ gāngcái zài jiàoshì lǐ zhǎo le hǎo jiǔ.
examples.english: A: Sorry, I accidentally took your book? B: It turns out the book is here with you; I was looking in the classroom for a long time just now.

examples.chinese: A:中明，請問學校圖書館幾點關？ B:你不知道啊？圖書館晚上九點關 。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhōngmíng, qǐngwèn xuéxiào túshūguǎn jǐ diǎn guān? B: Nǐ bù zhīdào a? Túshūguǎn wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn guān.
examples.english: A: Zhongming, may I ask what time the school library closes? B: You don't know? The library closes at 9 p.m.

examples.chinese: 公園的音樂晚會快要開始了，可不可以請你們幫我排那些椅子？
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán de yīnyuè wǎnhuì kuài yào kāishǐ le, kě bù kěyǐ qǐng nǐmen bāng wǒ pái nàxiē yǐzi?
examples.english: The park's music evening party is about to start; could you please help me line up those chairs?

examples.chinese: 聽說高鐵很快，你搭過沒有？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō gāotiě hěn kuài, nǐ dā guo méiyǒu?
examples.english: I heard the high-speed rail is very fast; have you ever taken it?

examples.chinese: 今年的表演比去年的更有意思，我覺得你應該來看。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de biǎoyǎn bǐ qùnián de gèng yǒu yìsi, wǒ juéde nǐ yīnggāi lái kàn.
examples.english: This year's performance is even more interesting than last year's; I think you should come see it.

examples.chinese: 捷運站的洗手間外面有很多人在排隊，你要去嗎？
examples.pinyin: Jiéyùn zhàn de xǐshǒujiān wàimiàn yǒu hěn duō rén zài páiduì, nǐ yào qù ma?
examples.english: Outside the restroom at the MRT station there are many people lining up; do you want to go?

examples.chinese: 你先幫我付，我明天再給你錢。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bāng wǒ fù, wǒ míngtiān zài gěi nǐ qián.
examples.english: You pay for me first; I'll give you the money tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 晚安！希望你有個好夢。
examples.pinyin: Wǎn'ān! Xīwàng nǐ yǒu ge hǎo mèng.
examples.english: Good night! I hope you have a good dream.

examples.chinese: 經理說，我們要一邊說笑話一邊介紹機器的功能，這樣子才賣得好。小簡是一個有愛心、有禮貌的人，像這樣子的男人你要好好把握啊！
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ shuō, wǒmen yào yībiān shuō xiàohua yībiān jièshào jīqì de gōngnéng, zhèyàngzi cái mài de hǎo. Xiǎo Jiǎn shì yīge yǒu àixīn, yǒu lǐmào de rén, xiàng zhèyàngzi de nánrén nǐ yào hǎohǎo bǎwò a!
examples.english: The manager said, we need to tell jokes while introducing the machine's functions, this way it will sell well. Xiao Jian is a caring and polite person; a man like this, you should hold on to him!

examples.chinese: 聽說小張離過三次婚，你想他還會再結婚嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō Xiǎo Zhāng lí guò sān cì hūn, nǐ xiǎng tā hái huì zài jiéhūn ma?
examples.english: I heard Xiao Zhang has been divorced three times; do you think he will get married again?

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？昨天晚上沒睡好嗎？ B:嗯。要不是開夜車趕報告， 現在也不會這麼沒精神。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Zuótiān wǎnshang méi shuì hǎo ma? B: Ńg. Yàobùshì kāi yèchē gǎn bàogào, xiànzài yě bù huì zhème méi jīngshén.
examples.english: A: What's wrong with you? Didn't you sleep well last night? B: Mm. If I hadn't stayed up late driving to finish my report, I wouldn't be so low on energy now.

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？看起來很不開心的樣子。 B:唉！工廠發生問題，今天又得加班處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Kàn qǐlái hěn bù kāixīn de yàngzi. B: Āi! Gōngchǎng fāshēng wèntí, jīntiān yòu děi jiābān chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: What's wrong? You look very unhappy. B: Alas! There's a problem at the factory; I have to work overtime again today to deal with it.

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: A:醫生說我應該多運動，少吃太鹹、太油的東西，這樣才不容易生病。 B:就是說嘛！我跟你說過好多次了，你怎麼不聽呢？
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng shuō wǒ yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tài xián, tài yóu de dōngxi, zhèyàng cái bù róngyì shēngbìng. B: Jiùshì shuō ma! Wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme bù tīng ne?
examples.english: A: The doctor said I should exercise more and eat less of things that are too salty or too oily; this way it's not easy to get sick. B: Exactly! I've told you many times, why don't you listen?

examples.chinese: 李太太擔心孩子因為吃得太少，長不高，你有什麼好主意？
examples.pinyin: Lǐ tàitai dānxīn háizi yīnwèi chī de tài shǎo, zhǎng bù gāo, nǐ yǒu shénme hǎo zhǔyì?
examples.english: Mrs. Li is worried that her child won't grow tall because he eats too little. Do you have any good ideas?

examples.chinese: 在你的國家，成年的孩子常跟父母住在一起，還是滿十八歲就搬出去了？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ de guójiā, chéngnián de háizi cháng gēn fùmǔ zhù zài yīqǐ, háishì mǎn shíbā suì jiù bān chūqù le?
examples.english: In your country, do children who have become adults often live with their parents, or do they move out as soon as they turn eighteen?

examples.chinese: A:我希望將來能當一名很棒的導演。 B:我相信只要你不斷地努力，就能夢想成真的！
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng yī míng hěn bàng de dǎoyǎn. B: Wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào nǐ bùduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn de!
examples.english: A: I hope that in the future I can become a great director. B: I believe that as long as you keep working hard, your dreams will come true!

examples.chinese: 這個城市的公車司機不找錢，要是你沒有公車卡，就得自己準備零錢。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de gōngchē sījī bù zhǎo qián, yàoshi nǐ méiyǒu gōngchē kǎ, jiù děi zìjǐ zhǔnbèi língqián.
examples.english: Bus drivers in this city don't give change; if you don't have a bus card, you have to prepare exact change yourself.

examples.chinese: 你回家經過賣韓國貨的超市時，可以順便幫我買兩包泡麵嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huíjiā jīngguò mài Hánguó huò de chāoshì shí, kěyǐ shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi liǎng bāo pàomiàn ma?
examples.english: When you pass by the supermarket that sells Korean merchandise on your way home, can you conveniently buy me two packs of instant noodles?

examples.chinese: 客人：這雙皮鞋我穿起來太緊了， 可以幫我換大一點的嗎？ 店員：沒問題，我幫你拿大一號的。
examples.pinyin: Kèrén: Zhè shuāng píxié wǒ chuān qǐlái tài jǐn le, kěyǐ bāng wǒ huàn dà yīdiǎn de ma? Diànyuán: Méi wèntí, wǒ bāng nǐ ná dà yī hào de.
examples.english: Customer: This pair of leather shoes is too tight for me; can you help me exchange them for a bigger size? Clerk: No problem, I'll get you a size larger.

examples.chinese: 你先別急著買，貨比三家不吃虧，多看幾家再決定吧！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bié jízhe mǎi, huò bǐ sān jiā bù chīkuī, duō kàn jǐ jiā zài juédìng ba!
examples.english: Don't rush to buy yet; shopping around at three stores won't hurt—look at a few more stores before deciding!

examples.chinese: 包小姐的眼光很好，一看就知道那件黃色外套的品質最好。妹妹：我希望將來找個又聰明又有錢 ，而且很體貼我的男朋友。 姊姊：妳的眼光太高了，恐怕找不到。
examples.pinyin: Bāo xiǎojiě de yǎnguāng hěn hǎo, yí kàn jiù zhīdào nà jiàn huángsè wàitào de pǐnzhí zuì hǎo. Mèimei: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái zhǎo ge yòu cōngmíng yòu yǒu qián, érqiě hěn tǐtiē wǒ de nánpéngyou. Jiějie: Nǐ de yǎnguāng tài gāo le, kǒngpà zhǎo bú dào.
examples.english: Miss Bao has a good eye; she can tell at a glance that the quality of that yellow coat is the best. Younger sister: I hope to find a boyfriend in the future who is smart, rich, and very considerate of me. Older sister: Your standards are too high; I'm afraid you won't find one.

examples.chinese: 有人說，生孩子容易，養小孩難，你覺得呢？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, shēng háizi róngyì, yǎng xiǎohái nán, nǐ juéde ne?
examples.english: Some people say that giving birth to a child is easy, but raising a child is difficult. What do you think?

examples.chinese: 對不起！我昨天跟你說話的態度不好，我向你道歉，請你別生氣了。
examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ! Wǒ zuótiān gēn nǐ shuōhuà de tàidù bù hǎo, wǒ xiàng nǐ dàoqiàn, qǐng nǐ bié shēngqì le.
examples.english: I'm sorry! My attitude when talking to you yesterday was not good. I apologize to you; please don't be angry anymore.

examples.chinese: 聽說坐月子時不能洗頭髮，要不然對身體不好，你相信這樣的說法嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zuòyuèzi shí bùnéng xǐ tóufa, yàobùrán duì shēntǐ bù hǎo, nǐ xiāngxìn zhèyàng de shuōfǎ ma?
examples.english: I heard that during confinement you can't wash your hair, otherwise it's bad for your health. Do you believe this version?

examples.chinese: 我的錢包丟了，裡面有護照、 信用卡，這件事很要緊，得馬上告訴警察。A:你怎麼一直咳嗽？要不要去看醫生？ B:不要緊，我吃過藥了，休息一下就好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo diū le, lǐmiàn yǒu hùzhào, xìnyòngkǎ, zhè jiàn shì hěn yàojǐn, děi mǎshàng gàosu jǐngchá. A: Nǐ zěnme yīzhí késòu? Yào bùyào qù kàn yīshēng? B: Bù yàojǐn, wǒ chī guò yào le, xiūxi yīxià jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: I lost my wallet; inside were my passport and credit card. This matter is very important; I must tell the police immediately. A: Why do you keep coughing? Do you want to see a doctor? B: It's not important; I've taken medicine, and I'll be fine after a little rest.

examples.chinese: 醫生說你肩膀疼的原因，是因為長時間打電腦的關係。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō nǐ jiānbǎng téng de yuányīn, shì yīnwèi cháng shíjiān dǎ diànnǎo de guānxì.
examples.english: The doctor said the reason your shoulder hurts is because of using the computer for a long time.

examples.chinese: 臺灣人在國外碰到問題時，可以立刻打0800-085-095「你幫我，你救我」這支電話求救。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān rén zài guówài pèngdào wèntí shí, kěyǐ lìkè dǎ 0800-085-095 “nǐ bāng wǒ, nǐ jiù wǒ” zhè zhī diànhuà qiújiù.
examples.english: When Taiwanese people encounter problems abroad, they can immediately call 0800-085-095, the “you help me, you save me” number, to ask for help.

examples.chinese: A:醫生，我求你快救救我的貓。 B:別急！我馬上檢查。
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng, wǒ qiú nǐ kuài jiùjiu wǒ de māo. B: Bié jí! Wǒ mǎshàng jiǎnchá.
examples.english: A: Doctor, I beg you to save my cat quickly. B: Don't worry! I'll examine it right away.

examples.chinese: 如果這個週末你沒有什麼打算，要不要跟我去看看臺灣規模最大的書店？
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhège zhōumò nǐ méiyǒu shénme dǎsuàn, yào bù yào gēn wǒ qù kànkan Táiwān guīmó zuì dà de shūdiàn?
examples.english: If you don't have any plans this weekend, do you want to go with me to see Taiwan's largest bookstore?

examples.chinese: 既然你不想衝浪，那就坐在海灘上曬曬太陽吧！
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ bù xiǎng chōnglàng, nà jiù zuò zài hǎitān shàng shài shài tàiyáng ba!
examples.english: Since you don't want to surf, then just sit on the beach and soak up some sun!

examples.chinese: 既然你那麼喜歡張小姐，就應該主動一點，約她去看電影、吃個飯什麼的。
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ nàme xǐhuān Zhāng xiǎojiě, jiù yīnggāi zhǔdòng yīdiǎn, yuē tā qù kàn diànyǐng, chī ge fàn shénme de.
examples.english: Since you like Miss Zhang so much, you should take the initiative a bit more—ask her out to a movie, a meal, or something.

examples.chinese: 要是你想知道山區天氣的情況，上網看看氣象預報就行了。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ xiǎng zhīdào shānqū tiānqì de qíngkuàng, shàngwǎng kànkan qìxiàng yùbào jiù xíng le.
examples.english: If you want to know the weather conditions in the mountains, just go online and check the weather forecast.

examples.chinese: A:怎麼回事？外面怎麼這麼吵？ B:鄰居在修理屋頂，快修理好了，你忍耐一下吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Zěnme huí shì? Wàimiàn zěnme zhème chǎo? B: Línjū zài xiūlǐ wūdǐng, kuài xiūlǐ hǎo le, nǐ rěnnài yīxià ba.
examples.english: A: What's the matter? Why is it so noisy outside? B: The neighbor is repairing the roof; it will be fixed soon, so please put up with it for a bit.

examples.chinese: 刷卡購物時，店員會先確認你的簽名是不是和信用卡上的相同。
examples.pinyin: Shuākǎ gòuwù shí, diànyuán huì xiān quèrèn nǐ de qiānmíng shì bùshì hé xìnyòngkǎ shàng de xiāngtóng.
examples.english: When paying by credit card, the clerk will first confirm whether your signature is the same as the one on the credit card.

examples.chinese: 還好你告訴我今天黃教授的課停課一次，要不然我就白跑一趟了。
examples.pinyin: Háihǎo nǐ gàosu wǒ jīntiān Huáng jiàoshòu de kè tíngkè yī cì, yàobùrán wǒ jiù bái pǎo yī tàng le.
examples.english: Good thing you told me that Professor Huang's class is canceled today; otherwise, I would have made a trip in vain.

examples.chinese: 你在名牌服裝的專櫃工作，我想聽聽看你對穿著和品味的看法。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài míngpái fúzhuāng de zhuānguì gōngzuò, wǒ xiǎng tīng tīng kàn nǐ duì chuānzhuó hé pǐnwèi de kànfǎ.
examples.english: You work at a designer clothing counter; I'd like to hear your opinion on dressing and taste.

examples.chinese: 我跟弟弟是雙胞胎，很多人都以為我是他，這樣的誤會我早就習慣了。A:何小姐只是我的鄰居，不是我的女朋友，大家都誤會了。 B:你對她很體貼，不但常送她上班，還常陪她逛街，大家對你們有誤會也是正常的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn dìdi shì shuāngbāotāi, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒ shì tā, zhèyàng de wùhuì wǒ zǎo jiù xíguàn le. A: Hé xiǎojiě zhǐshì wǒ de línjū, bùshì wǒ de nǚpéngyǒu, dàjiā dōu wùhuì le. B: Nǐ duì tā hěn tǐtiē, bùdàn cháng sòng tā shàngbān, hái cháng péi tā guàngjiē, dàjiā duì nǐmen yǒu wùhuì yě shì zhèngcháng de.
examples.english: My younger brother and I are twins; many people think I am him, and I've long been used to this kind of misunderstanding. A: Miss He is just my neighbor, not my girlfriend; everyone has misunderstood. B: You are very considerate to her; not only do you often take her to work, but you also often accompany her shopping. It's normal for everyone to have a misunderstanding about you two.

examples.chinese: A:聽說明天的會跟新商品的推銷計畫有關，你要參加嗎？ B:我是公司的安全人員，這個會應該跟我無關。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō míngtiān de huì gēn xīn shāngpǐn de tuīxiāo jìhuà yǒuguān, nǐ yào cānjiā ma? B: Wǒ shì gōngsī de ānquán rényuán, zhège huì yīnggāi gēn wǒ wúguān.
examples.english: A: I heard that tomorrow's meeting is related to the new product promotion plan; are you going to attend? B: I am the company's security personnel; this meeting should be unrelated to me.

examples.chinese: 有人說，男人的話題常跟政治有關，女人的話題不是名牌包、就是化妝品。你同意嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, nánrén de huàtí cháng gēn zhèngzhì yǒuguān, nǚrén de huàtí bùshì míngpái bāo, jiùshì huàzhuāngpǐn. Nǐ tóngyì ma?
examples.english: Some people say that men's topics are often related to politics, and women's topics are either designer bags or cosmetics. Do you agree?

examples.chinese: 我往東走，你往西走，我們兩個的方向剛好相反。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wǎng dōng zǒu, nǐ wǎng xī zǒu, wǒmen liǎng gè de fāngxiàng gānghǎo xiāngfǎn.
examples.english: I walk east, you walk west; our two directions are exactly opposite.

examples.chinese: 真正的朋友會幫助你、關心你，是絕對不會傷害你的。青少年常因為不了解而誤會父母的教育方式，或許等他們長大了，就能真正明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu huì bāngzhù nǐ, guānxīn nǐ, shì juéduì bù huì shānghài nǐ de. Qīngshàonián cháng yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér wùhuì fùmǔ de jiàoyù fāngshì, huòxǔ děng tāmen zhǎngdà le, jiù néng zhēnzhèng míngbai le.
examples.english: True friends will help you and care about you; they will absolutely not hurt you. Teenagers often misunderstand their parents' way of education because they don't understand; perhaps when they grow up, they will truly understand.

examples.chinese: 電視上正在播出跨年演唱會，節目非常吸引人，你快來看吧。
examples.pinyin: Diànshì shàng zhèngzài bōchū kuànián yǎnchànghuì, jiémù fēicháng xīyǐn rén, nǐ kuài lái kàn ba.
examples.english: The TV is broadcasting the New Year's Eve concert right now; the program is very attractive, so come watch it quickly.

examples.chinese: 我承認你的照相機是被我弄壞的，我一定負責把它修理好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chéngrèn nǐ de zhàoxiàngjī shì bèi wǒ nòng huài de, wǒ yīdìng fùzé bǎ tā xiūlǐ hǎo.
examples.english: I admit that your camera was broken by me; I will definitely take responsibility for fixing it.

examples.chinese: A:「快時尚」的服裝只有剛出來的頭幾個月受歡迎。 B:哦？你的意思是「快時尚」的衣服很快就失去魅力了嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: “Kuàishíshàng” de fúzhuāng zhǐyǒu gāng chūlái de tóu jǐ ge yuè shòu huānyíng. B: Ó? Nǐ de yìsi shì “kuàishíshàng” de yīfu hěn kuài jiù shīqù mèilì le ma?
examples.english: A: “Fast fashion” clothing is only popular for the first few months after it comes out. B: Oh? Do you mean that “fast fashion” clothes quickly lose their charm?

examples.chinese: 如果你想了解臺灣社會的人、事、物，最好親自來臺灣住一段時間。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng liǎojiě Táiwān shèhuì de rén, shì, wù, zuìhǎo qīnzì lái Táiwān zhù yí duàn shíjiān.
examples.english: If you want to understand the people, events, and things of Taiwanese society, it is best to come to Taiwan yourself and stay for a period of time.

examples.chinese: 如果你能掌握老師教學的重要內容，這次的測驗就一定能得到高分。為了測驗出學生的華語程度，學校希望學生參加華語文能力測驗。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ néng zhǎngwò lǎoshī jiàoxué de zhòngyào nèiróng, zhè cì de cèyàn jiù yídìng néng dédào gāo fēn. Wèile cèyàn chū xuéshēng de Huáyǔ chéngdù, xuéxiào xīwàng xuéshēng cānjiā Huáyǔwén nénglì cèyàn.
examples.english: If you can grasp the important content of the teacher’s teaching, you will definitely get a high score on this test. In order to test students’ Chinese proficiency, the school hopes students will take the Chinese proficiency test.

examples.chinese: 這個手錶你已經戴了快二十年了吧？他對你有甚麼特殊的意義呢？
examples.pinyin: Zhège shǒubiǎo nǐ yǐjīng dài le kuài èrshí nián le ba? Tā duì nǐ yǒu shénme tèshū de yìyì ne?
examples.english: You have already worn this watch for almost twenty years, right? Does it have any special meaning to you?

examples.chinese: 這個牌子的運動服在夜市賣五百元，可是在百貨公司賣兩千元，你覺得合理嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhège páizi de yùndòngfú zài yèshì mài wǔbǎi yuán, kěshì zài bǎihuò gōngsī mài liǎngqiān yuán, nǐ juéde hélǐ ma?
examples.english: This brand of sportswear sells for five hundred yuan at the night market, but sells for two thousand yuan at the department store—do you think that's reasonable?

examples.chinese: A:你知道辦理留學的手續需要準備哪些資料嗎？ B:我不清楚。你可以上網查查。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zhīdào bànlǐ liúxué de shǒuxù xūyào zhǔnbèi nǎxiē zīliào ma? B: Wǒ bù qīngchu. Nǐ kěyǐ shàngwǎng cháchá.
examples.english: A: Do you know what materials need to be prepared to deal with the procedures for studying abroad? B: I'm not sure. You can look it up online.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹的個性太單純了，別人說什麼她都相信，難怪常吃虧。經理找你談話，只是單純地想了解你對新工作適不適應，你別緊張。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei de gèxìng tài dānchún le, biérén shuō shénme tā dōu xiāngxìn, nánguài cháng chīkuī. Jīnglǐ zhǎo nǐ tánhuà, zhǐshì dānchún de xiǎng liǎojiě nǐ duì xīn gōngzuò shì bù shì yìng, nǐ bié jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: My younger sister's personality is too pure; she believes whatever others say, no wonder she often gets taken advantage of. The manager wants to talk with you simply to understand whether you are adapting to the new job; don't be nervous.

examples.chinese: 張太太一個人管三個孩子，家裡大大小小的事情也是她負責的，太辛苦了。姊姊：下個星期就要大學考試了，你怎麼不用功念書，反而天天出去玩？ 弟弟：妳別管我，這是我自己的事。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai yī gè rén guǎn sān gè háizi, jiālǐ dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqíng yě shì tā fùzé de, tài xīngkǔ le. Jiějie: Xià gè xīngqī jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, nǐ zěnme bù yònggōng niànshū, fǎn'ér tiāntiān chūqù wán? Dìdi: Nǐ bié guǎn wǒ, zhè shì wǒ zìjǐ de shì.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang manages three children all by herself, and she is also responsible for all the big and small matters at home; it's too hard. Older sister: The university exam is next week; why aren't you studying hard, but instead going out to play every day? Younger brother: Don't manage me; this is my own business.

examples.chinese: 員工：謝謝您幫了我一個大忙，這個小禮物請您收下。 主管：你太客氣了！這點兒小事真的沒什麼。
examples.pinyin: Yuángōng: Xièxie nín bāng le wǒ yī gè dà máng, zhège xiǎo lǐwù qǐng nín shōuxià. Zhǔguǎn: Nǐ tài kèqì le! Zhè diǎnr xiǎoshì zhēn de méishénme.
examples.english: Employee: Thank you for doing me a big favor; please accept this small gift. Supervisor: You're too polite! This little thing really is nothing serious.

examples.chinese: 只要你堅持每天學習一個小時的中文，我保證你的程度一定會越來越好的。石先生對自己的想法很堅持，從不接受別人的意見，所以很難相處。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ jiānchí měitiān xuéxí yí ge xiǎoshí de Zhōngwén, wǒ bǎozhèng nǐ de chéngdù yídìng huì yuèláiyuè hǎo de. Shí xiānsheng duì zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ hěn jiānchí, cóng bù jiēshòu biérén de yìjiàn, suǒyǐ hěn nán xiāngchǔ.
examples.english: As long as you insist on studying Chinese for one hour every day, I guarantee your level will definitely get better and better. Mr. Shi is very insistent on his own ideas and never accepts others' opinions, so he is hard to get along with.

examples.chinese: 要是你覺得這盤菜的味道太淡了，可以加一點醬料。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ juéde zhè pán cài de wèidào tài dàn le, kěyǐ jiā yìdiǎn jiàngliào.
examples.english: If you feel this dish's flavor is too light, you can add a little sauce.

examples.chinese: A:對不起，你的杯子被我打破了，我不是故意的。 B:沒關係！還好你沒受傷。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ, nǐ de bēizi bèi wǒ dǎpò le, wǒ bùshì gùyì de. B: Méi guānxi! Háohǎo nǐ méi shòushāng.
examples.english: A: Sorry, your cup was broken by me; I didn't do it on purpose. B: It's okay! Good thing you're not hurt.

examples.chinese: A:好久沒看到你父母了，請替我問候他們。 B:沒問題。
examples.pinyin: A: Hǎojiǔ méi kàndào nǐ fùmǔ le, qǐng tì wǒ wènhòu tāmen. B: Méi wèntí.
examples.english: A: I haven't seen your parents for a long time; please give them my regards. B: No problem.

examples.chinese: 那個網路商店經常賣假貨，你可別上當。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wǎnglù shāngdiàn jīngcháng mài jiǎhuò, nǐ kě bié shàngdàng.
examples.english: That online store often sells fake goods; you'd better not be tricked.

examples.chinese: 你知道第一次世界運動會是在哪裡舉行的嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào dì yī cì shìjiè yùndònghuì shì zài nǎlǐ jǔxíng de ma?
examples.english: Do you know where the first World Games were held?

examples.chinese: 只要照溫老師安排的課程，多閱讀、多練習，你的中文就會有很大的進步。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào zhào Wēn lǎoshī ānpái de kèchéng, duō yuèdú, duō liànxí, nǐ de Zhōngwén jiù huì yǒu hěn dà de jìnbù.
examples.english: As long as you follow the curriculum arranged by Teacher Wen, read more and practice more, your Chinese will make great progress.

examples.chinese: 我伯伯說，讀書與做人同樣重要，也是一輩子的事。與人溝通時，最重要的是讓對方清楚了解你想表達的意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bóbo shuō, dúshū yǔ zuòrén tóngyàng zhòngyào, yě shì yībèizi de shì. Yǔ rén gōutōng shí, zuì zhòngyào de shì ràng duìfāng qīngchǔ liǎojiě nǐ xiǎng biǎodá de yìsi.
examples.english: My uncle says that studying and being a good person are equally important, and are lifelong matters. When communicating with others, the most important thing is to let the other person clearly understand what you want to express.

examples.chinese: A:要不是你幫忙，現在我還找不到工作呢！ B:沒什麼，朋友之間本來就應該互相幫助。
examples.pinyin: A: Yàobùshì nǐ bāngmáng, xiànzài wǒ hái zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò ne! B: Méi shénme, péngyǒu zhījiān běnlái jiù yīnggāi hùxiāng bāngzhù.
examples.english: A: If it weren't for your help, I still wouldn't have found a job now! B: It's nothing; between friends, we should help each other by nature.

examples.chinese: 許經理有兩點值得我們學習，第一點是做事仔細，第二點是有耐心。你的白襯衫上面有一個黑點，快脫下來，我幫你洗一洗。
examples.pinyin: Xǔ jīnglǐ yǒu liǎng diǎn zhídé wǒmen xuéxí, dì yī diǎn shì zuòshì zǐxì, dì èr diǎn shì yǒu nàixīn. Nǐ de bái chènshān shàngmiàn yǒu yī gè hēi diǎn, kuài tuō xiàlái, wǒ bāng nǐ xǐ yī xǐ.
examples.english: Manager Xu has two points worth learning from: the first point is that he is careful in his work, and the second point is that he is patient. There is a black spot on your white shirt; quickly take it off, and I'll help you wash it.

examples.chinese: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english: The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 他最近對你說話的態度變得冷淡，你們之間是不是有什麼誤會？
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn duì nǐ shuōhuà de tàidù biàn de lěngdàn, nǐmen zhījiān shì bùshì yǒu shénme wùhuì?
examples.english: His attitude when speaking to you has recently become cold; is there some misunderstanding between you two?

examples.chinese: 某年某月的某一天，你會找到心中最理想的結婚對象，現在別急。
examples.pinyin: Mǒu nián mǒu yuè de mǒu yī tiān, nǐ huì zhǎodào xīnzhōng zuì lǐxiǎng de jiéhūn duìxiàng, xiànzài bié jí.
examples.english: On a certain day of a certain month in a certain year, you will find the most ideal marriage partner in your heart; don't rush now.

examples.chinese: 老婆：我叫你買豆漿，怎麼買了無糖的，真難喝！ 老公：妳又沒說清楚，怎麼能怪我。
examples.pinyin: Lǎopó: Wǒ jiào nǐ mǎi dòujiāng, zěnme mǎi le wútáng de, zhēn nánhē! Lǎogōng: Nǐ yòu méi shuō qīngchu, zěnme néng guài wǒ.
examples.english: Wife: I told you to buy soy milk; how come you bought the sugar-free kind? It tastes awful! Husband: You didn't say clearly, so how can you blame me?

examples.chinese: 在你的國家，第一次辦理護照得本人親自去，不能請別人代替嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ de guójiā, dì-yī cì bànlǐ hùzhào děi běnrén qīnzì qù, bùnéng qǐng biérén dàitì ma?
examples.english: In your country, the first time you apply for a passport, do you have to go in person yourself, and cannot ask someone else to do it for you?

examples.chinese: A:對這次新產品的銷售方式，你有什麼想法？ B:我在這方面沒什麼經驗，你可以去請教方經理。
examples.pinyin: A: Duì zhè cì xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu fāngshì, nǐ yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ? B: Wǒ zài zhè fāngmiàn méi shénme jīngyàn, nǐ kěyǐ qù qǐngjiào Fāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: A: Regarding the sales method for this new product, what ideas do you have? B: I don't have much experience in this aspect; you can go ask Manager Fang.

examples.chinese: A:要是你發現男朋友對你越來越冷淡，還常跟女網友約會， 你會原諒他嗎？ B:這麼花心的男人，絕對不值得原諒。
examples.pinyin: A: Yàoshi nǐ fāxiàn nánpéngyou duì nǐ yuèláiyuè lěngdàn, hái cháng gēn nǚ wǎngyǒu yuēhuì, nǐ huì yuánliàng tā ma? B: Zhème huāxīn de nánrén, juéduì bù zhídé yuánliàng.
examples.english: A: If you found out that your boyfriend was becoming colder and colder toward you and often went on dates with female internet friends, would you forgive him? B: A man who is such a playboy is absolutely not worth forgiving.

examples.chinese: 你聽了尤老闆勇敢克服困難、堅持到底的真實故事，有什麼感想？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tīng le Yóu lǎobǎn yǒnggǎn kèfú kùnnan, jiānchí dàodǐ de zhēnshí gùshi, yǒu shénme gǎnxiǎng?
examples.english: After hearing Boss You's true story of bravely overcoming difficulties and persevering to the end, what are your thoughts?

examples.chinese: 你忙不過來的時候就該找人幫忙，別讓自己累壞了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ máng bú guòlái de shíhou jiù gāi zhǎo rén bāngmáng, bié ràng zìjǐ lèihuài le.
examples.english: When you are too busy to manage, you should find someone to help; don't let yourself get exhausted.

examples.chinese: A:為什麼活動中心連一個人都沒有？今天不是有吉他社的表演嗎？ B:你搞錯了，演出日期是下個星期三。
examples.pinyin: A: Wèishénme huódòng zhōngxīn lián yí ge rén dōu méiyǒu? Jīntiān bú shì yǒu jítā shè de biǎoyǎn ma? B: Nǐ gǎo cuò le, yǎnchū rìqī shì xià ge xīngqīsān.
examples.english: A: Why is there not a single person at the activity center? Isn't there a guitar club performance today? B: You got it wrong; the performance date is next Wednesday.

examples.chinese: 有人說，這個世界是上帝創造的，你相信嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒurén shuō, zhège shìjiè shì Shàngdì chuàngzào de, nǐ xiāngxìn ma?
examples.english: Some people say that this world was created by God; do you believe it?

examples.chinese: 學生：明天就要大學考試了，我很緊張，怕考不好。 老師：你是很優秀的學生，我相信只要盡自己的能力，好好發揮實力，一定沒問題的。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng: Míngtiān jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, pà kǎo bù hǎo. Lǎoshī: Nǐ shì hěn yōuxiù de xuéshēng, wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào jìn zìjǐ de nénglì, hǎohǎo fāhuī shílì, yīdìng méi wèntí de.
examples.english: Student: The university exam is tomorrow; I'm very nervous and afraid I won't do well. Teacher: You are an excellent student; I believe that as long as you do your best according to your ability and fully demonstrate your strength, there will definitely be no problem.

examples.chinese: 太太：你喝醉了，別再喝了。 先生：好啦，好啦，還剩下一口，喝完就不喝了。
examples.pinyin: Tàitai: Nǐ hē zuì le, bié zài hē le. Xiānsheng: Hǎo la, hǎo la, hái shèngxià yī kǒu, hē wán jiù bù hē le.
examples.english: Wife: You're drunk; don't drink anymore. Husband: Okay, okay, there's still one sip left; after I finish it, I won't drink anymore.

examples.chinese: 公園附近的停車場還很空，你可以把車停到那裡去。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán fùjìn de tíngchēchǎng hái hěn kōng, nǐ kěyǐ bǎ chē tíng dào nàlǐ qù.
examples.english: The parking lot near the park is still very empty; you can park your car there.

examples.chinese: A:我太糊塗了，忘了把變更後的網路銀行密碼記下來。 B:這下子你得親自去銀行處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ tài hútu le, wàng le bǎ biàngēng hòu de wǎnglù yínháng mìmǎ jì xiàlái. B: Zhè xiàzi nǐ děi qīnzì qù yínháng chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: I was too careless and forgot to write down the changed internet banking password. B: Now you'll have to go to the bank in person to deal with it.

examples.chinese: A:聽說小金離婚了，你知道是怎麼回事嗎？ B:唉，這件事說起來都要怪小金，誰教他愛上了別的女生呢！
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō Xiǎo Jīn líhūn le, nǐ zhīdào shì zěnme huí shì ma? B: Āi, zhè jiàn shì shuō qǐlái dōu yào guài Xiǎo Jīn, shéi jiào tā ài shàng le bié de nǚshēng ne!
examples.english: A: I heard Xiao Jin got divorced. Do you know what happened? B: Sigh, as a matter of fact, it's all Xiao Jin's fault—who told him to fall in love with another girl!

examples.chinese: 這本中文教材是網路書店出版的，你得上網才買得到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn zhōngwén jiàocái shì wǎnglù shūdiàn chūbǎn de, nǐ děi shàngwǎng cái mǎi de dào.
examples.english: This Chinese textbook is published by an online bookstore; you have to go online to be able to buy it.

examples.chinese: 這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí. A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english: This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel. A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: 站在老闆背後的那個人已經通過了面試，明天就要來上班了。「每個成功男人的背後，都有一個偉大的女人。」你覺得這句話有道理嗎？
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhàn zài lǎobǎn bèihòu de nàge rén yǐjīng tōngguò le miànshì, míngtiān jiù yào lái shàngbān le. 2. Měi ge chénggōng nánrén de bèihòu, dōu yǒu yí ge wěidà de nǚrén. Nǐ juéde zhè jù huà yǒu dàolǐ ma?
examples.english: 1. The person standing behind the boss has already passed the interview and will come to work tomorrow. 2. Behind every successful man, there is a great woman. Do you think this saying makes sense?

examples.chinese: 跟大人比起來，小孩子的想法比較單純、天真，不會故意騙人。A:網友跟我借十萬塊錢，說他的家人生病住院了。 B:你太天真了，他是騙你的。
examples.pinyin: 1. Gēn dàrén bǐ qǐlái, xiǎoháizi de xiǎngfǎ bǐjiào dānchún, tiānzhēn, bú huì gùyì piàn rén. 2. A: Wǎngyǒu gēn wǒ jiè shí wàn kuài qián, shuō tā de jiārén shēngbìng zhùyuàn le. B: Nǐ tài tiānzhēn le, tā shì piàn nǐ de.
examples.english: 1. Compared with adults, children's thinking is simpler and more innocent; they won't deliberately deceive people. 2. A: An online friend borrowed a hundred thousand dollars from me, saying his family member was sick and hospitalized. B: You're too naive; he's deceiving you.

examples.chinese: 幸虧你來幫忙，要不然我一個人絕對忙不過來。幸虧我把資料都存在雲端，要不然找不到隨身碟，怎麼開會呢？
examples.pinyin: 1. Xìngkuī nǐ lái bāngmáng, yàobùrán wǒ yí ge rén juéduì máng bú guòlái. 2. Xìngkuī wǒ bǎ zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, yàobùrán zhǎo bú dào suíshēndié, zěnme kāihuì ne?
examples.english: 1. Thanks to your help, otherwise I definitely wouldn't be able to handle it alone. 2. Fortunately, I saved all the data in the cloud; otherwise, if I couldn't find the USB drive, how could we have the meeting?

examples.chinese: A:我對何小姐是真心的，為什麼她一直不肯接受呢？ B:你應該更關心她、更體貼她，讓她知道你是真心愛她的。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ duì Hé xiǎojiě shì zhēnxīn de, wèishénme tā yìzhí bù kěn jiēshòu ne? B: Nǐ yīnggāi gèng guānxīn tā, gèng tǐtiē tā, ràng tā zhīdào nǐ shì zhēnxīn ài tā de.
examples.english: A: I am sincere toward Miss He; why does she keep refusing to accept me? B: You should care about her more and be more considerate of her, so she knows you truly love her.

examples.chinese: 小偷：我又沒偷東西，為什麼抓我？ 警察：你先別動，只要看了商店攝影機錄下來的內容，就知道事實了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎotōu: Wǒ yòu méi tōu dōngxi, wèishénme zhuā wǒ? Jǐngchá: Nǐ xiān bié dòng, zhǐyào kàn le shāngdiàn shèyǐngjī lù xiàlái de nèiróng, jiù zhīdào shìshí le.
examples.english: Thief: I didn't steal anything, why are you arresting me? Police: Don't move first; as long as you look at what the store's camera recorded, you'll know the fact.

examples.chinese: A:你說老闆下個月要提高每個人的薪水，沒騙我吧？ B:這個消息是從他的口中說出來的，當然是真的。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ shuō lǎobǎn xià gè yuè yào tígāo měi gè rén de xīnshuǐ, méi piàn wǒ ba? B: Zhège xiāoxi shì cóng tā de kǒu zhōng shuō chūlái de, dāngrán shì zhēn de.
examples.english: A: You said the boss is going to raise everyone's salary next month—you're not fooling me, are you? B: This news came out of his own mouth; of course it's true.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì. 2. A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.
examples.english: 1. Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied. 2. A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say.

examples.chinese: 這是我和你之間的祕密，你絕對不可告訴別人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ hé nǐ zhījiān de mìmì, nǐ juéduì bùkě gàosu biérén.
examples.english: This is a secret between you and me; you absolutely must not tell anyone else.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 這課的漢字我都認得，但還不太會寫，所以筆試時好些字都寫錯了。弟弟：爺爺怎麼常把我和你的名字搞錯？ 哥哥：爺爺年紀太大了，腦子不清楚，好像不認得我們了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kè de Hànzì wǒ dōu rènde, dàn hái bù tài huì xiě, suǒyǐ bǐshì shí hǎoxiē zì dōu xiě cuò le. Dìdi: Yéye zěnme cháng bǎ wǒ hé nǐ de míngzi gǎo cuò? Gēge: Yéye niánjì tài dà le, nǎozi bù qīngchu, hǎoxiàng bù rènde wǒmen le.
examples.english: I can recognize all the Chinese characters in this lesson, but I am not yet able to write them well, so I wrote many characters incorrectly on the written test. Younger brother: Why does Grandpa often mix up your name and mine? Older brother: Grandpa is too old and his mind is unclear; it seems he no longer recognizes us.

examples.chinese: 誰都無法告訴你生命的意義是什麼，只能自己去尋找答案。
examples.pinyin: Shéi dōu wúfǎ gàosù nǐ shēngmìng de yìyì shì shénme, zhǐ néng zìjǐ qù xúnzhǎo dá'àn.
examples.english: No one is able to tell you what the meaning of life is; you can only search for the answer yourself.

examples.chinese: 打破你們的碗盤是我的錯，我會對自己的行為負責，付你們這個費用。
examples.pinyin: Dǎpò nǐmen de wǎnpán shì wǒ de cuò, wǒ huì duì zìjǐ de xíngwéi fùzé, fù nǐmen zhège fèiyòng.
examples.english: Breaking your dishes was my fault; I will take responsibility for my behavior and pay you this fee.

examples.chinese: 今天是星期一，你不去學校嗎？
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīngqí yī, nǐ bú qù xuéxiào ma?
examples.english: It is Monday today; aren’t you going to school?

examples.chinese: 中午呢？你中午回家嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhōngwǔ ne? Nǐ zhōngwǔ huí jiā ma?
examples.english: How about noon? Are you coming back home at noon?

examples.chinese: 你幾點下課？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jǐ diǎn xiàkè?
examples.english: What time do you get out of class?

examples.chinese: 今天是星期五，明天是週末，你們要不要來我家？
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīngqí wǔ, míngtiān shì zhōumò, nǐmen yào bú yào lái wǒ jiā?
examples.english: Today is Friday and it is the weekend tomorrow. Do you want to come to my place?

examples.chinese: 明天是九月二十三號……啊！是妳的生日！
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān shì jiǔ yuè èrshísān hào... Ā! Shì nǐ de shēngrì!
examples.english: It is September 23rd tomorrow...Ah! It is your birthday!

examples.chinese: 妳想送她什麼？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng sòng tā shénme?
examples.english: What would you like to give her?

examples.chinese: 友美愛看書，我想送她兩本中文書，你呢？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi ài kànshū, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā liǎng běn Zhōngwén shū, nǐ ne?
examples.english: Youmei loves reading. I would like to give her two books in Chinese as a gift. How about you?

examples.chinese: 五十塊錢很便宜！妳看，哪個顏色漂亮？
examples.pinyin: Wǔshí kuài qián hěn piányí! Nǐ kàn, nǎ ge yánsè piàoliang?
examples.english: It is inexpensive! Look, which color is better?

examples.chinese: 好啊！你想喝什麼？咖啡還是茶？
examples.pinyin: Hǎo a! Nǐ xiǎng hē shénme? Kāfēi háishì chá?
examples.english: Okay! What would you like to drink? Coffee or tea?

examples.chinese: 友美，妳這個週末要做什麼？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi, nǐ zhè ge zhōumò yào zuò shénme?
examples.english: Youmei, what are you going to do this weekend?

examples.chinese: 妳星期六下午有空嗎？我們一起去喝下午茶，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xīngqí liù xiàwǔ yǒukòng ma? Wǒmen yìqǐ qù hē xiàwǔ chá, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: Are you available on Saturday afternoon? How about we have afternoon tea together?

examples.chinese: 好啊！你想去哪裡？
examples.pinyin: Hǎo a! Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎlǐ?
examples.english: Sounds great! Where do you want to go?

examples.chinese: 客廳的桌子上有一個錢包，是不是你的？
examples.pinyin: Kètīng de zhuōzi shàng yǒu yí ge qiánbāo, shì bú shì nǐ de?
examples.english: In the living room, there is a wallet on the table. Is that yours?

examples.chinese: 沙發上面、下面跟旁邊都沒有。媽，妳幫我找，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: Shāfā shàngmiàn, xiàmiàn gēn pángbiān dōu méiyǒu. Mā, nǐ bāng wǒ zhǎo, hǎo ma?
examples.english: It is neither on the sofa, under the sofa, nor beside the sofa. Mom, could you find it for me?

examples.chinese: 我很忙，現在要去廚房做飯，你再去房間找吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn máng, xiànzài yào qù chúfáng zuòfàn, nǐ zài qù fángjiān zhǎo ba.
examples.english: I am very busy and I am going to the kitchen to cook now. You go check your room again.

examples.chinese: 今天天氣不錯，海邊的風景也很漂亮，我想去游泳，妳們想去嗎？
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì búcuò, hǎibiān de fēngjǐng yě hěn piàoliàng, wǒ xiǎng qù yóuyǒng, nǐmen xiǎng qù ma?
examples.english: The weather is pretty good today, so is the view at the beach. I want to go swimming. Do you want to go?

examples.chinese: 我不會游泳。宜文，妳會游泳嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú huì yóuyǒng. Yíwén, nǐ huì yóuyǒng ma?
examples.english: I can not swim. Yiwen, can you swim?

examples.chinese: 打網球怎麼樣？中明說妳的網球打得很好，我們一起去打吧。
examples.pinyin: Dǎ wǎngqiú zěnmeyàng? Zhōngmíng shuō nǐ de wǎngqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo, wǒmen yìqǐ qù dǎ ba.
examples.english: How about playing tennis? Zhongming said you play it well. Let’s go play it together.

examples.chinese: 你不要常常在家上網、看電腦、玩手機，應該去運動。明天我有空，我們可以一起去騎腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào chángcháng zài jiā shàngwǎng, kàn diànnǎo, wán shǒujī, yīnggāi qù yùndòng. Míngtiān wǒ yǒukòng, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ qù qí jiǎotàchē.
examples.english: Don’t surf the internet, use the computer or play on the cell phone at home often. You should go exercise. I am available tomorrow. We can go ride bikes together.

examples.chinese: 元真，我們明天幾點去找妳的韓國朋友？
examples.pinyin: Yuánzhēn, wǒmen míngtiān jǐ diǎn qù zhǎo nǐ de Hánguó péngyǒu?
examples.english: Yuanzhen, what time are we going to meet up with your Korean friends tomorrow?

examples.chinese: 可是我不知道怎麼走，妳知道嗎？
examples.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ bù zhīdào zěnme zǒu, nǐ zhīdào ma?
examples.english: But I don’t know how to get there, do you?

examples.chinese: 友美，妳看，天美飯店在大學路。我現在知道怎麼走了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi, nǐ kàn, Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài Dàxué Lù. Wǒ xiànzài zhīdào zěnme zǒu le.
examples.english: Look, Youmei. Tianmei Hotel is on Daxue Road. Now I know how to get there.

examples.chinese: 妳想怎麼去？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng zěnme qù?
examples.english: How do you want to get there?

examples.chinese: 元真，妳的這條裙子真好看，我很喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Yuánzhēn, nǐ de zhè tiáo qúnzi zhēn hǎokàn, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
examples.english: Yuanzhen, your skirt is very beautiful; I like it very much.

examples.chinese: 妳知道去哪裡買這個牌子的衣服嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào qù nǎlǐ mǎi zhè ge páizi de yīfu ma?
examples.english: Do you know where you can get this clothing brand?

examples.chinese: 妳胖了嗎？我不覺得啊，我跟妳一起去看。我也想去買今年夏天的新衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ pàng le ma? Wǒ bù juéde a, wǒ gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù kàn. Wǒ yě xiǎng qù mǎi jīnnián xiàtiān de xīn yīfu.
examples.english: Have you gained weight? I don’t think so. I can go check with you. I would like to buy the new summer collections.

examples.chinese: 妳看，這條黃色的褲子不錯吧？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, zhè tiáo huángsè de kùzi búcuò ba?
examples.english: Look! This pair of yellow pants is nice, isn’t it?

examples.chinese: 妳覺得怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: What do you think?

examples.chinese: 沒關係，我們可以下個週末再來看。對了，妳要買鞋子吧？
examples.pinyin: Méiguānxi, wǒmen kěyǐ xià ge zhōumò zài lái kàn. Duìle, nǐ yào mǎi xiézi ba?
examples.english: It’s okay; we can come again next weekend. By the way, you want to buy shoes, don’t you?

examples.chinese: 友美，這幾個句子的意思我不太懂，妳可以教我嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi, zhè jǐ ge jùzi de yìsi wǒ bú tài dǒng, nǐ kěyǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
examples.english: Youmei, I don’t quite understand these sentences. Could you teach me?

examples.chinese: 好。我先回宿舍做功課，再跟你一起去找他。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo. Wǒ xiān huí sùshè zuò gōngkè, zài gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù zhǎo tā.
examples.english: Okay. I will go back to the dormitory to do my homework first, then I will go to see him with you.

examples.chinese: 我們去問老師，也許他可以幫你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen qù wèn lǎoshī, yěxǔ tā kěyǐ bāng nǐ.
examples.english: Let’s ask the teacher; maybe he can help you.

examples.chinese: 最近很多人感冒，你們要戴口罩，也要常常洗手。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén gǎnmào, nǐmen yào dài kǒuzhào, yě yào chángcháng xǐshǒu.
examples.english: Many people got sick lately. You need to wear a surgical mask and wash your hands often.

examples.chinese: 妳可以帶一些水果去看國安，跟他說應該多喝水，也要多休息。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ qù kàn Guó'ān, gēn tā shuō yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, yě yào duō xiūxí.
examples.english: You can take some fruit to visit Guoan. Tell him to drink plenty of water and get much rest as well.

examples.chinese: 你覺得哪裡不舒服？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde nǎlǐ bù shūfu?
examples.english: Where are you uncomfortable? (What brings you here today?)

examples.chinese: 我會給你三天的藥。你要記得多喝一點兒水，要是發燒了，就吃紅色的藥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì gěi nǐ sān tiān de yào. Nǐ yào jìde duō hē yìdiǎnr shuǐ, yàoshi fāshāo le, jiù chī hóngsè de yào.
examples.english: I will give you medicine for 3 days. Remember to drink plenty of water. If you have a fever, then take the red pill.

examples.chinese: 我記得有羊、馬、兔子……，最特別的是龍。（打開課本）妳看看……
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìdé yǒu yáng, mǎ, tùzi..., zuì tèbié de shì lóng. (dǎkāi kèběn) Nǐ kànkan...
examples.english: I remember there are goats, horses, rabbits..., and the most special one is the dragon. (Open the textbook) You see...

examples.chinese: 中明，你手裡拿著什麼？
examples.pinyin: Zhōngmíng, nǐ shǒu lǐ ná zhe shénme?
examples.english: Zhongming, what you are holding in your hand?

examples.chinese: 這是我朋友做的，因為他屬虎。妳知道十二生肖嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ péngyou zuò de, yīnwèi tā shǔ hǔ. Nǐ zhīdào shí'èr shēngxiào ma?
examples.english: This is the lantern that my friend made because his Chinese zodiac animal sign is tiger. Do you know the Chinese animal zodiac?

examples.chinese: 這個星期六是元宵節，妳跟友美會去看燈會嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xīngqī liù shì Yuánxiāojié, nǐ gēn Yǒuměi huì qù kàn dēnghuì ma?
examples.english: This Saturday is the Lantern Festival. Will you and Youmei go to see the Lantern Carnival?

items.wordHook: a 亻(person) points straight at 尔(you) → that word is 你(you).

examples.chinese: 我有一個英國朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge Yīngguó péngyǒu.
examples.english: I have a British friend.

examples.chinese: 我有一位英國老師和兩位日本老師。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí wèi Yīngguó lǎoshī hé liǎng wèi Rìběn lǎoshī.
examples.english: I have one British teacher and two Japanese teachers.

examples.chinese: 我要坐飛機到英國去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào zuò fēijī dào Yīngguó qù.
examples.english: I want to take an airplane to England.

examples.chinese: 我希望明年可以去英國學英文。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng míngnián kěyǐ qù Yīngguó xué Yīngwén.
examples.english: I hope to go to England to study English next year.

examples.chinese: A:你已經決定明年去英國了嗎？ B:我還沒做決定。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ yǐjīng juédìng míngnián qù Yīngguó le ma? B: Wǒ hái méi zuò juédìng.
examples.english: A: Have you already decided to go to England next year? B: I haven't made a decision yet.

examples.chinese: 我跟朋友這次去英國玩了八天七夜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn péngyou zhè cì qù Yīngguó wán le bā tiān qī yè.
examples.english: This time I went to England with a friend and played for eight days and seven nights.

examples.chinese: 大寶明年有去英國留學的打算，所以找了家庭教師幫他補習， 希望提高英文程度。
examples.pinyin: Dàbǎo míngnián yǒu qù Yīngguó liúxué de dǎsuàn, suǒyǐ zhǎo le jiātíng jiàoshī bāng tā bǔxí, xīwàng tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù.
examples.english: Dabao plans to study abroad in the UK next year, so he found a private tutor to help him with cram tutoring, hoping to improve his English level.

examples.chinese: 大龍最近買了一套音響，每天回到家就聽他最愛的英國樂團的音樂。
examples.pinyin: Dàlóng zuìjìn mǎi le yī tào yīnxiǎng, měitiān huí dào jiā jiù tīng tā zuì ài de Yīngguó yuètuán de yīnyuè.
examples.english: Dalong recently bought a stereo set; every day when he gets home, he listens to music by his favorite British band.

examples.chinese: 現在我不渴，我很餓。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ bù kě, wǒ hěn è.
examples.english: I am not thirsty now, I am really hungry.

examples.chinese: 現在我不渴，我很餓。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ bù kě, wǒ hěn è.
examples.english: I am not thirsty now, I am really hungry.

examples.chinese: 你很渴嗎？我有一瓶飲料，你要不要喝？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hěn kě ma? Wǒ yǒu yì píng yǐnliào, nǐ yào bú yào hē?
examples.english: Are you thirsty? I have a bottle of beverage, would you like to have some?

examples.chinese: 人人都渴望浪漫的愛情和幸福的家庭，不過自由自在的單身生活也是不錯的。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu kěwàng làngmàn de àiqíng hé xìngfú de jiātíng, búguò zìyóuzìzài de dānshēn shēnghuó yě shì búcuò de.
examples.english: Everyone longs for romantic love and a happy family, but a free and easy single life is also not bad.

items.wordHook: With no 氵(water) left, a parched throat asks 曷(what) to drink when feeling 渴(thirsty).

examples.chinese: 我朋友說這家餐廳的咖啡很好喝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu shuō zhè jiā cāntīng de kāfēi hěn hǎohē.
examples.english: My friend said this restaurant’s coffee is good.

examples.chinese: 我男朋友不太喜歡說話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nán péngyǒu bú tài xǐhuān shuōhuà.
examples.english: My boyfriend does not like to talk very much.

examples.chinese: 打網球怎麼樣？中明說妳的網球打得很好，我們一起去打吧。
examples.pinyin: Dǎ wǎngqiú zěnmeyàng? Zhōngmíng shuō nǐ de wǎngqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo, wǒmen yìqǐ qù dǎ ba.
examples.english: How about playing tennis? Zhongming said you play it well. Let’s go play it together.

examples.chinese: 我們應該常常說請、謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi chángcháng shuō qǐng, xièxie.
examples.english: We should say ‘please’, ‘thank you’ often.

examples.chinese: 老師說要送我們書，我們都很高興。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō yào sòng wǒmen shū, wǒmen dōu hěn gāoxìng.
examples.english: The teacher said she/he is going to give us some books as gifts; we are all very happy.

examples.chinese: 聽說這部電影很有趣，我們晚一起去看，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù. Wǒmen wǎnshang yìqǐ qù kàn, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: I heard that this movie is very interesting. How about we go to see it tonight?

examples.chinese: 說中文容易，唱中文歌也不難。
examples.pinyin: Shuō Zhōngwén róngyì, chàng Zhōngwén gē yě bù nán.
examples.english: Speaking Chinese is easy, and singing Chinese songs is not difficult either.

examples.chinese: 說中文容易，唱中文歌也不難。
examples.pinyin: Shuō Zhōngwén róngyì, chàng Zhōngwén gē yě bù nán.
examples.english: Speaking Chinese is easy, and singing Chinese songs is not difficult either.

examples.chinese: A:我妹妹說這件衣服很好看，你覺得呢？ B:這件衣服真的很好看！
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ mèimei shuō zhè jiàn yīfu hěn hǎokàn, nǐ juéde ne? B: Zhè jiàn yīfu zhēn de hěn hǎokàn!
examples.english: A: My younger sister says this piece of clothing looks very nice; what do you think? B: This piece of clothing really looks very nice!

examples.chinese: 你會說幾種語言？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huì shuō jǐ zhǒng yǔyán?
examples.english: How many languages can you speak?

examples.chinese: 我常常跟日本朋友練習說日文。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng gēn Rìběn péngyǒu liànxí shuō Rìwén.
examples.english: I often practice speaking Japanese with Japanese friends.

examples.chinese: 聽說下星期一我們要用別的教室，你知道是哪間教室嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō xià xīngqīyī wǒmen yào yòng bié de jiàoshì, nǐ zhīdào shì nǎ jiān jiàoshì ma?
examples.english: I heard that next Monday we will use a different classroom; do you know which classroom it is?

examples.chinese: 我不懂他的意思，不知道應該說什麼，所以有點兒緊張。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù dǒng tā de yìsi, bù zhīdào yīnggāi shuō shénme, suǒyǐ yǒudiǎnr jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: I don't understand what he means and don't know what I should say, so I am a bit nervous.

examples.chinese: 他跟我說，他感冒了，要去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Tā gēn wǒ shuō, tā gǎnmào le, yào qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: He said to me that he caught a cold and needs to go see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 他說：「你唱得很好。」這個中文句子對嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ chàng de hěn hǎo.” Zhège Zhōngwén jùzi duì ma?
examples.english: He said, “You sing very well.” Is this Chinese sentence correct?

examples.chinese: 醫生說，我應該多喝水，不需要吃藥。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō, wǒ yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, bù xūyào chī yào.
examples.english: The doctor said I should drink more water and don't need to take medicine.

examples.chinese: A:聽說你弟弟生病了，他現在怎麼樣？ B:他好了，明天可以去學校了。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō nǐ dìdi shēngbìng le, tā xiànzài zěnmeyàng? B: Tā hǎo le, míngtiān kěyǐ qù xuéxiào le.
examples.english: A: I heard your younger brother got sick; how is he now? B: He has gotten well; he can go to school tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 我昨天跟朋友說了很多話，我們都很開心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān gēn péngyou shuō le hěn duō huà, wǒmen dōu hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Yesterday I said a lot to my friend, and we were both very happy.

examples.chinese: 他說話很有趣，所以每個人都喜歡跟他聊天。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà hěn yǒuqù, suǒyǐ měi ge rén dōu xǐhuan gēn tā liáotiān.
examples.english: He speaks interestingly, so everyone likes to chat with him.

examples.chinese: 我感冒了，想給老師打電話，跟他說我不能去上課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnmào le, xiǎng gěi lǎoshī dǎ diànhuà, gēn tā shuō wǒ bù néng qù shàngkè.
examples.english: I caught a cold; I want to call the teacher to tell him I can't go to class.

examples.chinese: 我有一些台灣朋友，所以說中文的機會很多。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yìxiē Táiwān péngyǒu, suǒyǐ shuō Zhōngwén de jīhuì hěn duō.
examples.english: I have some Taiwanese friends, so I have many chances to speak Chinese.

examples.chinese: 考試開始以後，我們不可以跟同學說話。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì kāishǐ yǐhòu, wǒmen bù kěyǐ gēn tóngxué shuōhuà.
examples.english: After the exam starts, we cannot talk with classmates.

examples.chinese: 我的母親常對我說：「你要多看書，少玩手機。」
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de mǔqīn cháng duì wǒ shuō: “Nǐ yào duō kàn shū, shǎo wán shǒujī.”
examples.english: My mother often says to me: 'You should read more books and play less on your phone.'

examples.chinese: 聽說這家工廠的工人都很辛苦，可是老闆給的錢不多。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè jiā gōngchǎng de gōngrén dōu hěn xīnkǔ, kěshì lǎobǎn gěi de qián bù duō.
examples.english: I heard that the workers at this factory all work very hard, but the money the boss gives is not much.

examples.chinese: 兒子跟女兒都在睡覺，你不要說得太大聲。
examples.pinyin: Érzi gēn nǚ'ér dōu zài shuìjiào, nǐ búyào shuō de tài dàshēng.
examples.english: Both my son and daughter are sleeping; don't speak too loudly.

examples.chinese: A:我覺得語言比數學有趣多了？ B:我同意你說的。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ juéde yǔyán bǐ shùxué yǒuqù duō le? B: Wǒ tóngyì nǐ shuō de.
examples.english: A: I think languages are much more interesting than math? B: I agree with what you said.

examples.chinese: 我同事說那家店的麵包很好吃，大人、小孩都喜歡，很受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngshì shuō nà jiā diàn de miànbāo hěn hǎochī, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xǐhuān, hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: My colleague says that bakery's bread is very delicious; both adults and children like it—it's very popular.

examples.chinese: 聽說高鐵很快，你搭過沒有？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō gāotiě hěn kuài, nǐ dā guo méiyǒu?
examples.english: I heard the high-speed rail is very fast; have you ever taken it?

examples.chinese: 經理說，我們要一邊說笑話一邊介紹機器的功能，這樣子才賣得好。小簡是一個有愛心、有禮貌的人，像這樣子的男人你要好好把握啊！
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ shuō, wǒmen yào yībiān shuō xiàohua yībiān jièshào jīqì de gōngnéng, zhèyàngzi cái mài de hǎo. Xiǎo Jiǎn shì yīge yǒu àixīn, yǒu lǐmào de rén, xiàng zhèyàngzi de nánrén nǐ yào hǎohǎo bǎwò a!
examples.english: The manager said, we need to tell jokes while introducing the machine's functions, this way it will sell well. Xiao Jian is a caring and polite person; a man like this, you should hold on to him!

examples.chinese: 小鐘昨天晚上做了好幾個夢，沒睡好，難怪今天精神很不好。有人說，有夢最美。應該趁著年輕勇敢地做夢，更要努力讓夢想變成真的。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōng zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le hǎo jǐ ge mèng, méi shuì hǎo, nánguài jīntiān jīngshén hěn bù hǎo. Yǒu rén shuō, yǒu mèng zuì měi. Yīnggāi chènzhe niánqīng yǒnggǎn de zuòmèng, gèng yào nǔlì ràng mèngxiǎng biànchéng zhēn de.
examples.english: Xiao Zhong had several dreams last night and didn't sleep well; no wonder he is in very low spirits today. Some people say that having dreams is the most beautiful thing. You should bravely dream while you are young, and even more, work hard to make your dreams come true.

examples.chinese: 出國學習語言可以了解外國的文化，再說，也可以認識外國朋友，非常值得。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó xuéxí yǔyán kěyǐ liǎojiě wàiguó de wénhuà, zàishuō, yě kěyǐ rènshi wàiguó péngyou, fēicháng zhídé.
examples.english: Going abroad to study a language can help you understand foreign cultures; moreover, you can also meet foreign friends—it's very worthwhile.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳最辣的牛肉麵， 小程挑戰過好幾次，可惜都沒吃完。寫劇本對我來說是個很大的挑戰，但是也能得到不少收穫，所以我願意試試。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng zuì là de niúròumiàn, Xiǎo Chéng tiǎozhàn guò hǎo jǐ cì, kěxī dōu méi chī wán. Xiě jùběn duì wǒ lái shuō shì ge hěn dà de tiǎozhàn, dànshì yě néng dédào bùshǎo shōuhuò, suǒyǐ wǒ yuànyì shìshi.
examples.english: Xiao Cheng has challenged the spiciest beef noodles at this restaurant several times, but unfortunately he never finished them. Writing scripts is a big challenge for me, but I can also gain a lot from it, so I am willing to give it a try.

examples.chinese: 聽說小張離過三次婚，你想他還會再結婚嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō Xiǎo Zhāng lí guò sān cì hūn, nǐ xiǎng tā hái huì zài jiéhūn ma?
examples.english: I heard Xiao Zhang has been divorced three times; do you think he will get married again?

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: A:醫生說我應該多運動，少吃太鹹、太油的東西，這樣才不容易生病。 B:就是說嘛！我跟你說過好多次了，你怎麼不聽呢？
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng shuō wǒ yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tài xián, tài yóu de dōngxi, zhèyàng cái bù róngyì shēngbìng. B: Jiùshì shuō ma! Wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme bù tīng ne?
examples.english: A: The doctor said I should exercise more and eat less of things that are too salty or too oily; this way it's not easy to get sick. B: Exactly! I've told you many times, why don't you listen?

examples.chinese: 謝先生是從很有名的學校畢業的，但是聽說因為吃不了苦，什麼工作都做得不久。
examples.pinyin: Xiè xiānsheng shì cóng hěn yǒumíng de xuéxiào bìyè de, dànshì tīngshuō yīnwèi chī bùliǎo kǔ, shénme gōngzuò dōu zuò de bùjiǔ.
examples.english: Mr. Xie graduated from a very famous school, but I heard that because he can't endure hardship, he doesn't last long at any job.

examples.chinese: 店員把這台咖啡機的特色說明得非常清楚，聽了他的說明以後，大家都很感興趣。
examples.pinyin: Diànyuán bǎ zhè tái kāfēijī de tèsè shuōmíng de fēicháng qīngchǔ, tīngle tā de shuōmíng yǐhòu, dàjiā dōu hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: The clerk explained the features of this coffee machine very clearly. After hearing his explanation, everyone was very interested.

examples.chinese: 媽媽替我報名了亞洲鋼琴比賽，她說只要我肯努力，一定會有好成績的。
examples.pinyin: Māma tì wǒ bàomíngle Yàzhōu gāngqín bǐsài, tā shuō zhǐyào wǒ kěn nǔlì, yīdìng huì yǒu hǎo chéngjī de.
examples.english: My mother signed me up for the Asian Piano Competition. She said that as long as I am willing to work hard, I will definitely get good results.

examples.chinese: 對我來說，冬天的樂趣就是戴著厚厚的手套，和朋友玩雪球。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, dōngtiān de lèqù jiùshì dài zhe hòu hòu de shǒutào, hé péngyǒu wán xuěqiú.
examples.english: For me, the joy of winter is wearing thick gloves and playing snowballs with friends.

examples.chinese: 爺爺去過阿里山好幾回，每次去都看到不同的風景，他說非常值得。
examples.pinyin: Yéye qù guò Ālǐshān hǎo jǐ huí, měi cì qù dōu kàn dào bùtóng de fēngjǐng, tā shuō fēicháng zhídé.
examples.english: Grandpa has been to Alishan several times; every time he goes, he sees different scenery, and he says it's very worthwhile.

examples.chinese: 舅舅對我很好，不管我遇到什麼挑戰，只要跟他說一聲，他一定會幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Jiùjiu duì wǒ hěn hǎo, bùguǎn wǒ yùdào shénme tiǎozhàn, zhǐyào gēn tā shuō yì shēng, tā yídìng huì bāngmáng.
examples.english: My uncle is very good to me; no matter what challenges I encounter, as long as I give him a mention, he will definitely help.

examples.chinese: 媽媽對哥哥說，以他現在剛上班的情況，不能急著買房子，得等錢存夠了再買。
examples.pinyin: Māma duì gēge shuō, yǐ tā xiànzài gāng shàngbān de qíngkuàng, bùnéng jízhe mǎi fángzi, děi děng qián cún gòu le zài mǎi.
examples.english: Mom said to older brother, "Given your current situation of just starting work, you can't rush to buy a house; you have to wait until you've saved enough money before buying."

examples.chinese: 小藍什麼都不怕，就是怕跟女生說話，只要一說話，他的臉就紅了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎolán shénme dōu bú pà, jiùshì pà gēn nǚshēng shuōhuà, zhǐyào yì shuōhuà, tā de liǎn jiù hóng le.
examples.english: Xiaolan is not afraid of anything; he is exactly afraid of talking to girls. As soon as he talks, his face turns red.

examples.chinese: 醫生說那個病人得住院，要是三天以內都沒發燒、頭也不痛了，就可以出院了。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō nàge bìngrén děi zhùyuàn, yàoshi sān tiān yǐnèi dōu méi fāshāo, tóu yě bú tòng le, jiù kěyǐ chūyuàn le.
examples.english: The doctor said that patient has to be hospitalized; if within three days he has no fever and his head no longer hurts, then he can be discharged.

examples.chinese: 有人說，生孩子容易，養小孩難，你覺得呢？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, shēng háizi róngyì, yǎng xiǎohái nán, nǐ juéde ne?
examples.english: Some people say that giving birth to a child is easy, but raising a child is difficult. What do you think?

examples.chinese: 對不起！我昨天跟你說話的態度不好，我向你道歉，請你別生氣了。
examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ! Wǒ zuótiān gēn nǐ shuōhuà de tàidù bù hǎo, wǒ xiàng nǐ dàoqiàn, qǐng nǐ bié shēngqì le.
examples.english: I'm sorry! My attitude when talking to you yesterday was not good. I apologize to you; please don't be angry anymore.

examples.chinese: 就要開會了，可是我同事還沒把新產品的說明資料準備好，真叫人緊張。
examples.pinyin: Jiù yào kāihuì le, kěshì wǒ tóngshì hái méi bǎ xīn chǎnpǐn de shuōmíng zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo, zhēn jiào rén jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: The meeting is about to start, but my colleague still hasn't prepared the explanatory materials for the new product, which really makes one nervous.

examples.chinese: 聽說坐月子時不能洗頭髮，要不然對身體不好，你相信這樣的說法嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zuòyuèzi shí bùnéng xǐ tóufa, yàobùrán duì shēntǐ bù hǎo, nǐ xiāngxìn zhèyàng de shuōfǎ ma?
examples.english: I heard that during confinement you can't wash your hair, otherwise it's bad for your health. Do you believe this version?

examples.chinese: 新聞報告說颱風快來了，出門時得注意安全。
examples.pinyin: Xīnwén bàogào shuō táifēng kuài lái le, chūmén shí děi zhùyì ānquán.
examples.english: The news report says a typhoon is coming soon; when going out, you must pay attention to safety.

examples.chinese: 那輛汽車突然從路口開了出來， 把我嚇了一跳。聽說經理後天就要離開公司了。 這個消息太突然了，大家一時沒辦法接受。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng qìchē tūrán cóng lùkǒu kāi le chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yī tiào. Tīngshuō jīnglǐ hòutiān jiù yào líkāi gōngsī le. Zhège xiāoxi tài tūrán le, dàjiā yīshí méi bànfǎ jiēshòu.
examples.english: That car suddenly drove out from the intersection and startled me. I heard that the manager is leaving the company the day after tomorrow. This news is too sudden; everyone couldn't accept it for a moment.

examples.chinese: 醫生說你肩膀疼的原因，是因為長時間打電腦的關係。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō nǐ jiānbǎng téng de yuányīn, shì yīnwèi cháng shíjiān dǎ diànnǎo de guānxì.
examples.english: The doctor said the reason your shoulder hurts is because of using the computer for a long time.

examples.chinese: 一聽說颱風快來了，許多民眾就去超市搶購蔬菜、水果、泡麵等食物。
examples.pinyin: Yì tīngshuō táifēng kuài lái le, xǔduō mínzhòng jiù qù chāoshì qiǎnggòu shūcài, shuǐguǒ, pàomiàn děng shíwù.
examples.english: As soon as they heard that a typhoon was coming, many people rushed to the supermarket to buy vegetables, fruit, instant noodles, and other foods.

examples.chinese: 有一些父母不讓孩子去夜店，主要是因為聽說那裡有人吸毒，也買得到毒品。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē fùmǔ bù ràng háizi qù yèdiàn, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi tīngshuō nàlǐ yǒu rén xīdú, yě mǎi de dào dúpǐn.
examples.english: Some parents don't let their children go to nightclubs, mainly because they've heard that people take drugs there and that drugs can be bought there.

examples.chinese: 這個平板的使用說明寫得很詳細，客人自己看就能明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège píngbǎn de shǐyòng shuōmíng xiě de hěn xiángxì, kèrén zìjǐ kàn jiù néng míngbai le.
examples.english: The user manual for this tablet is written in great detail; customers can understand it just by reading it themselves.

examples.chinese: 記者說參加這次慢跑活動的人數已經超過了一百人，可是我數來數去只有五十幾個。
examples.pinyin: Jìzhě shuō cānjiā zhè cì mànpǎo huódòng de rénshù yǐjīng chāoguò le yìbǎi rén, kěshì wǒ shǔ lái shǔ qù zhǐyǒu wǔshí jǐ ge.
examples.english: The reporter said the number of people participating in this jogging event has already exceeded one hundred, but I counted and counted and there were only fifty-some.

examples.chinese: 小在追求夢想的路上，別太在意別人說什麼，只要不斷地努力，就能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshàng, bié tài zàiyì biérén shuō shénme, zhǐyào búduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, don't care too much about what others say; as long as you keep working hard, your dreams can come true.

examples.chinese: 氣象預報說，從明天起一連三天，中部以北地氣溫只有十五度，出門時最好加件外套。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào shuō, cóng míngtiān qǐ yīlián sān tiān, zhōngbù yǐběi dìqū qìwēn zhǐyǒu shíwǔ dù, chūmén shí zuìhǎo jiā jiàn wàitào.
examples.english: The weather forecast says that starting tomorrow for three days in a row, the temperature in the central and northern regions will be only 15 degrees; when going out, it's best to add a jacket.

examples.chinese: 就我對小林的了解，他是一個很實在的人，不但做事認真，說話也不誇張。
examples.pinyin: Jiù wǒ duì Xiǎo Lín de liǎojiě, tā shì yīgè hěn shízài de rén, bùdàn zuòshì rènzhēn, shuōhuà yě bù kuāzhāng.
examples.english: With regard to my understanding of Xiao Lin, he is a very honest person; not only does he work seriously, but he also doesn't exaggerate when he speaks.

examples.chinese: 張先生的個性很活潑、說話很幽默，跟他聊天總是很愉快。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn huópō, shuōhuà hěn yōumò, gēn tā liáotiān zǒngshì hěn yúkuài.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang's personality is very lively and his speech is very humorous; chatting with him is always very pleasant.

examples.chinese: 對連電腦都不知道怎麼打開的人來說，上網購物是一件非常困難的事情。
examples.pinyin: Duì lián diànnǎo dōu bù zhīdào zěnme dǎkāi de rén lái shuō, shàngwǎng gòuwù shì yī jiàn fēicháng kùnnán de shìqíng.
examples.english: For people who don't even know how to turn on a computer, shopping online is a very difficult thing.

examples.chinese: 在所有的同事中，我覺得小周最好相處了。他的性格開朗、說話幽默，還常主動幫忙，跟他相處起來很愉快、很自在。
examples.pinyin: Zài suǒyǒu de tóngshì zhōng, wǒ juéde Xiǎo Zhōu zuì hǎo xiāngchǔ le. Tā de xìnggé kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, hái cháng zhǔdòng bāngmáng, gēn tā xiāngchǔ qǐlái hěn yúkuài, hěn zìzài.
examples.english: Among all my colleagues, I think Xiao Zhou is the easiest to get along with. He has a cheerful personality, speaks humorously, and often offers help proactively; getting along with him is very pleasant and relaxed.

examples.chinese: 像衝浪、滑雪那樣的戶外活動，又刺激又好玩，不用說，絕對能吸引青少年。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng chōnglàng, huáxuě nàyàng de hùwài huódòng, yòu cìjī yòu hǎowán, bùyòng shuō, juéduì néng xīyǐn qīngshàonián.
examples.english: Outdoor activities like surfing and skiing are both exciting and fun; needless to say, they can definitely attract teenagers.

examples.chinese: A:聽說明天的會跟新商品的推銷計畫有關，你要參加嗎？ B:我是公司的安全人員，這個會應該跟我無關。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō míngtiān de huì gēn xīn shāngpǐn de tuīxiāo jìhuà yǒuguān, nǐ yào cānjiā ma? B: Wǒ shì gōngsī de ānquán rényuán, zhège huì yīnggāi gēn wǒ wúguān.
examples.english: A: I heard that tomorrow's meeting is related to the new product promotion plan; are you going to attend? B: I am the company's security personnel; this meeting should be unrelated to me.

examples.chinese: 對華人來說，孔子是地位最高、最偉大的老師，他的思想影響了很多人。
examples.pinyin: Duì Huárén lái shuō, Kǒngzǐ shì dìwèi zuì gāo, zuì wěidà de lǎoshī, tā de sīxiǎng yǐngxiǎng le hěn duō rén.
examples.english: For Chinese people, Confucius is the teacher with the highest position and the greatest, and his thoughts have influenced many people.

examples.chinese: 有人說，男人的話題常跟政治有關，女人的話題不是名牌包、就是化妝品。你同意嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, nánrén de huàtí cháng gēn zhèngzhì yǒuguān, nǚrén de huàtí bùshì míngpái bāo, jiùshì huàzhuāngpǐn. Nǐ tóngyì ma?
examples.english: Some people say that men's topics are often related to politics, and women's topics are either designer bags or cosmetics. Do you agree?

examples.chinese: 有人說發生大地震以前，小動物會亂跑、亂叫，這是很自然的現象。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō fāshēng dà dìzhèn yǐqián, xiǎo dòngwù huì luàn pǎo, luàn jiào, zhè shì hěn zìrán de xiànxiàng.
examples.english: Some people say that before a major earthquake occurs, small animals will run around and make noise; this is a very natural phenomenon.

examples.chinese: 住在學校宿舍有一些限制，比如說晚上十點前必須回到宿舍。
examples.pinyin: Zhù zài xuéxiào sùshè yǒu yīxiē xiànzhì, bǐrú shuō wǎnshang shí diǎn qián bìxū huídào sùshè.
examples.english: Living in the school dormitory has some restrictions, for example, you must return to the dormitory before ten o'clock at night.

examples.chinese: 小戴第一次跟女朋友的父母見面時，緊張得不得了，說話、吃飯都很不自在。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Dài dì yī cì gēn nǚpéngyǒu de fùmǔ jiànmiàn shí, jǐnzhāng de bùdéliǎo, shuōhuà, chīfàn dōu hěn bù zìzài.
examples.english: When Xiǎo Dài met his girlfriend's parents for the first time, he was extremely nervous, and he was very uncomfortable both talking and eating.

examples.chinese: 不少外國人說，臺灣最大的魅力是人們能夠接受不同的文化、語言和想法，所以在臺灣生活非常自在。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō, Táiwān zuì dà de mèilì shì rénmen nénggòu jiēshòu bùtóng de wénhuà, yǔyán hé xiǎngfǎ, suǒyǐ zài Táiwān shēnghuó fēicháng zìzài.
examples.english: Many foreigners say that Taiwan's greatest charm is that people can accept different cultures, languages, and ideas, so living in Taiwan is very comfortable.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，小感冒只要多喝水、多休息就行了，不需要看病、吃藥。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, xiǎo gǎnmào zhǐyào duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxi jiù xíng le, bù xūyào kànbìng, chī yào.
examples.english: Generally speaking, for a minor cold, you just need to drink more water and rest more; you don't need to see a doctor or take medicine.

examples.chinese: 對爺爺來說，所謂的「好孩子」，就是很孝順、有禮貌、功課好的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Duì yéye lái shuō, suǒwèi de "hǎo háizi", jiùshì hěn xiàoshùn, yǒu lǐmào, gōngkè hǎo de háizi.
examples.english: To Grandpa, a so-called "good child" is a child who is very filial, polite, and does well in school.

examples.chinese: 這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化。張老闆開會開得太久，沒趕上飛機，只好花錢再買一張機票了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lùyíng huódòng yīnwèi táifēng bàn bù chéng le, kěyǐ shuō jìhuà yǒngyuǎn méi bànfǎ gǎnshàng biànhuà. Zhāng lǎobǎn kāihuì kāi de tài jiǔ, méi gǎnshàng fēijī, zhǐhǎo huā qián zài mǎi yī zhāng jīpiào le.
examples.english: This camping activity couldn't be held because of the typhoon; you could say that plans can never catch up with changes. Boss Zhang's meeting went on too long, and he didn't catch the plane, so he had no choice but to spend money to buy another ticket.

examples.chinese: 好幾個人都看到他跟這場火災有關，他不但不承認，反而說是鄰居做的。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo jǐ ge rén dōu kàndào tā gēn zhè chǎng huǒzāi yǒuguān, tā búdàn bù chéngrèn, fǎn'ér shuō shì línjū zuò de.
examples.english: Several people saw that he was connected to this fire; not only did he not admit it, but instead he said the neighbor did it.

examples.chinese: 老師說這次口試的題目不難，回答是只要放輕鬆、別緊張，就沒問題了。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō zhè cì kǒushì de tímù bù nán, huídá shì zhǐyào fàng qīngsōng, bié jǐnzhāng, jiù méi wèntí le.
examples.english: The teacher said the questions on this oral exam are not hard; the answer is that as long as you relax and don't be nervous, there's no problem.

examples.chinese: 李先生經常咳嗽，可是他完全不在意。直到今天咳得說不出話來了，才肯去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng jīngcháng késòu, kěshì tā wánquán bù zàiyì. Zhídào jīntiān ké de shuō bù chū huà lái le, cái kěn qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: Mr. Li often coughs, but he doesn't care at all. It was not until today, when he coughed so much that he couldn't speak, that he was willing to go see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹的個性太單純了，別人說什麼她都相信，難怪常吃虧。經理找你談話，只是單純地想了解你對新工作適不適應，你別緊張。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei de gèxìng tài dānchún le, biérén shuō shénme tā dōu xiāngxìn, nánguài cháng chīkuī. Jīnglǐ zhǎo nǐ tánhuà, zhǐshì dānchún de xiǎng liǎojiě nǐ duì xīn gōngzuò shì bù shì yìng, nǐ bié jǐnzhāng.
